description: Abstract class 'WizardAbstract' defining common functionality for conditional formatting wizard in PHPSpreadsheet library, including cell range handling, style management, and cell reference adjustments.

classes.name: WizardAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods and properties for constructing and managing conditional formatting rules in PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wizard with a cell range.

methods.name: setCellRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range and updates reference cell accordingly.

methods.name: setReferenceCellForExpressions
methods.description: Extracts reference cell data for expression calculations based on the cell range.

methods.name: getStopIfTrue
methods.description: Returns whether to stop further rules if this rule is true.

methods.name: setStopIfTrue
methods.description: Sets whether to stop applying further rules if this one is true.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style object associated with the wizard.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets the style object for the wizard.

methods.name: validateOperand
methods.description: Validates and formats an operand based on its type.

methods.name: reverseCellAdjustment
methods.description: Reverses cell reference adjustments based on the reference cell.

methods.name: reverseAdjustCellRef
methods.description: Reverses adjustments in cell references within a condition string.

methods.name: conditionCellAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts cell references within a condition based on the wizard's reference row and column.

methods.name: cellConditionCheck
methods.description: Adjusts cell references within a condition string.

methods.name: adjustConditionsForCellReferences
methods.description: Applies cell reference adjustments to a list of conditions.
